anomaly_policy: retain historical unresolved candidates; additionally use each profile/strategy/horizon full-chronology mature slippage10 ledger (including purged_cross_split) with >=4 observations: statistics.quantiles(n=4,method=inclusive), strictly outside Q1-3IQR or Q3+3IQR creates a candidate; fewer than 4 creates no new IQR candidate; no separate partition thresholds; all remain primary; exclusion is sensitivity only and never selects parameters
anomaly_retention_match: union exact signal_date/stock_id/horizon; never transfer across horizon; unrepresented prior candidates retained in manifest source counts, not synthetic trades
batch_coverage_policy: Monday-Sunday weeks; check from the first selected batch through the last fully ended week strictly before signal_date, including ended weeks after the latest batch; scheduled sessions but no effective batch means missing_open_week; fully closed weeks allowed; calendar unknown unsupported; current unfinished week never missing; report batch count and calendar span, never require 7-day spacing
cohort_policy: shared data eligibility not shared selected signals; each profile/strategy/horizon starts empty at its profile start; 8-vs-12 comparison only common_12; no inherited pre-start positions
feature_contrast_policy: before condition interpretation; fixed high>=10%, low<=-10%, middle=(-10%,10%); negative<0% remains independent failure indicator; report feature distributions, counts and payoff under identical profile/strategy/horizon/slippage/partition/anomaly basis; descriptive only, no tuning
feature_contrast_sensitivity: immutable prior candidate flags only; never use newly detected full-chronology IQR flags to select or train parameters; all primary contrasts retain every realized position
financial_scope: monthly revenue excluded; EPS, gross margin, operating margin, operating income, non-operating income, net income, quarterly and annual financial statements all excluded
holder_interpretation: 400+ and 1000+ bands overlap; aggregate percentage trends do not prove the same holders continuously bought
largest_positive_jump_share: max(positive adjacent changes)/sum(positive adjacent changes); no positive changes means missing with reason, never changes eligibility
new_anomaly_flag_match: union exact signal_date/stock_id/horizon across this research profiles and strategies; propagate the same candidate flag across slippage scenarios; retain each detecting ledger and its fences as provenance
operation_policy: next exchange session open=D0; exit calendar[entry_index+horizon] close; signal_date strictly greater than prior exit_date; missing entry not established; missing exit or immature remains locked; maturity checked before indexing beyond calendar
outcome_policy: win >0; neutral =0; failure <0; high-return hit >=10%; loss <=-10%; raw_price_cashflow_unadjusted research proxy, not verified total return or brokerage execution
price_policy: unchanged annual current-version observed-history, warmup, source-quality and four-decimal frozen-selector price/volume gates
slope_formula: 7*(N*sum(d*p)-sum(d)*sum(p))/(N*sum(d*d)-sum(d)^2); d=integer days from first batch; p=Decimal percentage points; exact numerator sign; no epsilon or prior rounding
split_policy: entry_date; train if entry<split and exit<split; purged_cross_split if entry<split<=exit; validation if entry>=split; never reset chronology locks at split
tdcc_window_policy: last N global effective batch dates<=signal_date; require the same stock and all four necessary bands in every date; no older substitution, zero fill or forward fill
universe_policy: reconstruct historical daily price universe; preserve price-supported and price-qualified rows independently of TDCC; no old selected-signal or TDCC-four-batch prefilter
weekly_publication_policy: derived per-stock Decimal offsets relative to first complete batch only; no absolute holding percentages and no private raw records; full validation rereads SHA-bound private source, published-only validation explicitly does not
